summary:
​Project Overview: AstroGuard
​Welcome to AstroGuard — pioneering the future of human health and safety in space exploration.
​As commercial spaceflight rapidly expands, humanity is venturing further and staying longer in microgravity environments. However, space travel takes a severe toll on the human body, leading to muscle atrophy, bone density loss, and neurological disturbances.
​AstroGuard is an advanced, integrated bio-monitoring and protection ecosystem designed to safeguard astronauts and space tourists alike. By combining cutting-edge Edge AI, space-grade biometric sensors, and localized physiological support, our system actively preserves physical and neurological health without the need for grueling pre-training or constant ground-station supervision.
​Whether for commercial space tourism companies, national space agencies, or private spacefarers, AstroGuard ensures that every journey beyond Earth is safe, secure, and biologically stable.
details:
​AstroGuard is an advanced, integrated bio-monitoring and protection ecosystem designed to safeguard astronauts and commercial space tourists in microgravity environments.

​How it works & What it does: It actively tracks critical physiological parameters (such as heart rate, neurological waves, and muscle stress) using space-grade biometric sensors and processes this data locally via Edge AI. This allows the system to provide real-time health insights, prevent muscle atrophy, and maintain biological stability without needing constant ground-station supervision.

​Benefits & Impact: The project significantly reduces health risks associated with long-duration space missions, lowers physical stress for space travelers, and makes commercial spaceflight safer and more accessible.

​Tools, Languages & Technologies: Developed using cutting-edge Edge AI algorithms, biometric sensor frameworks, and web simulation interfaces to ensure seamless bio-synchronization and low-latency performance.

​Creativity & Considerations: AstroGuard stands out by shifting from reactive medical checks to proactive, localized, autonomous health protection. Our team carefully considered factors such as power efficiency, data privacy in deep space, and user comfort to build a reliable, astronaut-friendly ecosystem.
